verdicts.reason: A is a shrunken copy of the square design dropped left of centre. Large empty blue areas sit on both sides, and the T stem stops just short of the bottom edge instead of bleeding off it, so the banner shape goes unused, but the headline's line breaks and the text-to-T relationship survive. B has the same small, centred, dead-space problem and is worse: 'NOW!' is orphaned on its own line, which breaks the headline's first line apart, and 'TO ANIMALS' straddles the red/blue stem edge more awkwardly.
